sentences.en: The school's teaching quality received high accreditation.
sentences.zh: 这所学校教学质量得到了高度认可。

sentences.en: Before applying, make sure your degree has international accreditation.
sentences.zh: 申请之前，请确保你的学位已经获得国际认证。

sentences.en: The charity's work was given formal accreditation by the government body.
sentences.zh: 该慈善机构的工作得到了政府机构的正式认可。
